baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive verb at word 3 and the instrumental phrase at word 4 join communal extinction to an overwhelming cause.
baseline_models.mechanism: A force characterized by exceeding measure overruns the community until no viable collective remains.

activation_trace.role: Ruin and extinction supply the terminal effect on the named community.
An overwhelming punishment supplies the external cause that carries ruin to completion.

changed_reading.before: Thamud were killed by a punishment.
changed_reading.after: Thamud are depicted as a whole community overrun past recoverability by a punishment whose defining feature is excess.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative-passive destruction at word 3 is linked by ba to the overstepping noun at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots form a reflexive causal loop: crossing the limit is also entry into the peril that destroys the crosser.

activation_trace.role: Self-casting into peril makes destruction a path entered, not only an impact received.
Rebellious overstepping supplies the boundary-crossing that opens that path.

changed_reading.before: A punishment arrived after an independent act of transgression.
changed_reading.after: Their overstepping is itself the operative medium through which they enter destruction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The instrument noun at word 4 can denote physical force beyond bounds, while word 3 can evoke a deadly place or passage.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uncontained material surge converts the environment into a lethal medium, so destruction is spatial engulfment rather than only a judicial label.

activation_trace.role: A deadly abyss or wilderness supplies the spatial condition in which passage becomes fatal.
Overflowing force supplies the material excess that turns the setting lethal.

changed_reading.before: The instrument is an unspecified punitive event.
changed_reading.after: The instrument is live as an uncontained surge that makes the surrounding medium itself destructive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine instrument noun at word 4 can be personified as an overbearing agent or regime acting through the passive at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coercive power becomes self-consuming: the order that subdues a people also functions as the means of their collective ruin.

activation_trace.role: Collective ruin supplies the outcome of the social mechanism.
The overbearing tyrant supplies a personal or institutional carrier of destructive excess.

changed_reading.before: An impersonal calamity destroys the people from outside.
changed_reading.after: A tyrannical person or coercive order can be heard as the instrument through which the community is undone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly converts air, striking, sound, and impact into event; this activates the focus noun as an overbound acoustic force whose pressure extinguishes.

activation_trace.role: Extinction supplies the acoustic event's terminal effect.
The split-root voice or noise sense makes excessive sound lexically available in the focus noun.
One thing striking another supplies the initiating impact immediately before the focus.
A blow that rebukes the hearer gives the impact an auditory and admonitory function.
A harsh sounding vibration extends impact into sustained noise in the parallel destruction formula.
Air sent into an object supplies the pressure-to-sound transition.
Impact and its sound turn the acoustic strike into a realized event.

structural_cues: 69:4 places the striking event immediately before the focus destruction.
69:6 repeats the passive-destruction-with-ba construction for a noisy wind.
69:13-15 scale one blast into the occurrence of the great event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies striking, noise, blown air, impact, and a focus-root voice branch; I infer that they form an acoustic causal chain. They may instead remain separate event labels while the focus noun keeps the generic punishment sense.

changed_reading.before: The focus names an abstract overwhelming punishment.
changed_reading.after: The punishment can be heard materially as a pressure-laden strike or cry that exceeds the community's capacity to remain intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same overstepping root later modifies water, yet carriage within a moving container follows; excess is therefore not intrinsically one outcome, but becomes destructive or preserving according to containment and bearing.

activation_trace.role: Extinction marks the outcome when excessive force is not safely borne.
Overflowing physical force makes the focus instrument a material excess.
The repeated root explicitly locates excess in rising water.
Water's appearing, entering, and increasing supplies the expanding medium.
Bearing a visible load supplies the counter-operation that keeps persons above the excess.
Flowing movement supplies a contained way to travel with rather than be erased by the medium.

structural_cues: 69:11 repeats the focus root before immediately reversing expected destruction into carriage.
The focus ba marks destructive instrumentality, whereas 69:11 places persons as a borne object within the overflowing scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root repetition, excessive water, carrying, and flowing; I infer that containment changes the effect of excess from erasure to transport. The live alternative is that the verses present unrelated historical outcomes and only share a broad excess image.

changed_reading.before: Excess itself is the intrinsically lethal instrument.
changed_reading.after: Uncontained excess destroys, while excess met by bearing and containment can become the medium across which life is carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bodily and collective residue disappears, but the event is deliberately converted into a reminder and enclosed in receptive awareness; annihilation of the people generates persistence of the warning.

activation_trace.role: Extinction supplies the absence that requires another mode of remaining.
Bodies thrown to the ground materialize the collapse of the parallel people.
Emptiness makes the fallen form a vacated shell rather than a surviving collective.
The remainder branch, under explicit negation, removes bodily or social residue.
Deliberate transformation supplies the conversion of catastrophe into another state.
A reminder supplies the form in which the erased event remains active.
Enclosing meaning in the heart supplies durable internal containment.
Attentive acceptance supplies the aperture through which the warning survives.

structural_cues: 69:7-8 move from visible fallen forms to the question of any remainder.
69:12 states a purpose of making the preceding episode into remembrance and pairs it with receptive hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinction, no remainder, deliberate transformation, reminder, and receptive containment; I infer a compensating transfer from communal existence to remembered signal. The pronoun in 69:12 may target the vessel or broader episode rather than 69:5 alone, but the focus destruction remains inside that episode.

changed_reading.before: Destruction means that the people simply cease to remain.
changed_reading.after: Their physical and collective remainder vanishes, yet the destruction is made to persist as meaning held by a receptive ear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and exit from obedience initiate a sequence of seizure, linked restraint, and forced insertion; the focus's self-entered peril becomes a whole trajectory whose later material stages expose its direction.

activation_trace.role: Entry into one's own peril supplies the trajectory rather than a detached endpoint.
Overstepping supplies the initiating movement beyond a protective limit.
Assigning the warning to falsehood supplies the first relational break.
Departure from obedience turns that break into enacted boundary crossing.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the reversal from self-directed crossing to external capture.
Connected links materialize accumulated consequence as continuous restraint.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the path's final forced enclosure.

structural_cues: 69:10 names disobedience and seizure in one causal sentence.
69:30-32 unfold capture, binding, and insertion as successive imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, disobedience, seizure, linked restraint, and insertion; I infer that these disclose the direction latent in self-casting into destruction. The alternative is a purely judicial sequence imposed after, rather than generated through, the offenders' crossing.

changed_reading.before: Transgression and punishment are two adjacent events.
changed_reading.after: Transgression opens a path that reverses free crossing into capture and enclosure, so the punishment is the completed geometry of the initial overstep.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence of the destruction root takes coercive capacity as what vanishes; this reverses the focus's apparent agent-patient relation so that dominating power is not only destructive but destructible.

activation_trace.role: Communal ruin supplies the focus endpoint.
Tyrannical agency supplies the coercive power that initially appears to do the destroying.
The repeated ruin root now applies to the disappearance of efficacy from its speaker.
Power and governing capacity identify what the later destruction deactivates.

structural_cues: The focus uses the destruction root for a people; 69:29 repeats it in a lament over lost authority.
The focus instrument can name tyrannical agency, while the later object is the speaker's own capacity to dominate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tyrant branch and a later destruction-plus-authority collocation; I infer a thematic reversal in which coercive power consumes and then loses itself. The alternative is that 69:29 only reports an individual's post-judgment loss without redefining 69:5.

changed_reading.before: A dominating force destroys Thamud's bodies from outside.
changed_reading.after: Their ruin can include the unmaking of the dominating capacity they embodied or trusted; authority moves from apparent instrument to perishing object.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later hypothetical sequence makes verbal overreach lead to seizure, forceful cutting of the life-bearing conduit, and absence of any barrier; this supplies a precise systems model for how crossing a limit becomes extinction.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping supplies the initiating breach of limit.
Extinction supplies the result of losing the sustaining connection.
Attributing speech that was not given supplies the specific form of verbal excess.
Seizure for wrongdoing converts the breach into enforced consequence.
Force and effective right supply the power by which seizure is executed.
Clean severance supplies the operation that interrupts continuity.
The life artery identifies the sustaining conduit on which the whole organism depends.
A separating barrier, explicitly unavailable in context, removes the last interrupt to severance.

structural_cues: 69:44-47 is a tightly ordered conditional chain from wrongful speech to irreversible bodily interruption.
69:4 already places denial immediately before the focus destruction, allowing the later speech-chain to reactivate that boundary breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrongful attribution, seizure, force, severance, a life conduit, and no barrier; I infer this as a systems analogy for the focus roots, not as identity between the later hypothetical subject and Thamud. The alternative is that the chain is locally rhetorical and does not specify the earlier destruction mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The community is erased by an undifferentiated overwhelming impact.
changed_reading.after: Destruction can be modeled as the precise interruption of a life-bearing connection after a boundary is crossed, with no barrier left able to halt the cut.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's overstepping is later opposed by deliberate self-placement inside protection, while regret and covering activate exposure; destruction becomes a boundary failure in which concealment is not the same as a genuine shield.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the proper limit supplies departure from a protected relation.
Extinction supplies the consequence of exposure to the overbound force.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the positive counter-movement to overstepping.
Being stripped of protection supplies the exposed state disclosed by regret.
Covering supplies a false substitute for protection that can hide without preventing harm.

structural_cues: 69:48 and 69:50 place genuine protection and uncovered regret near the surah's conclusion.
The focus root defines departure beyond a limit, allowing protection to read as a maintained boundary rather than mere fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overstepping, self-protection, exposure, and covering; I infer that their spatial relations sharpen the focus destruction as failed boundary maintenance. The alternative is an ethical contrast with no claim about the earlier event's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a one-time external blow.
changed_reading.after: The blow completes a prior exposure: overstepping leaves the community outside genuine protection, while its own coverings cannot function as a shield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates rare topographic branches of the split focus root rather than its moral or punitive center. It remains anchored in the exact focus noun and in the destruction root's deadly-place branch, while later height, mountain, and leveling images give it a coherent material mechanism. Render only as a topographic echo or secondary spatial reading, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 can evoke a smooth raised outcrop or elevated place, and word 3 can evoke the lethal abyss or wilderness into which height reverses.

activation_trace.role: A fatal drop or deadly terrain supplies the downward endpoint of the spatial reversal.
A smooth high outcrop supplies a hard elevated form within the focus noun.
The non-dominant mapping reinforces raised place as a live spatial branch.
Increase and elevation supply the unstable upward vector.
Concentrated solid height supplies the large-scale material body.
Pounding to level ground supplies the reversal that annihilates raised form.

changed_reading.before: The focus instrument is only an abstract punishment or rebellious excess.
changed_reading.after: A secondary material image appears: destructive excess is raised hard form whose elevation reverses into leveling and a fatal fall.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it joins the focus root's destitution branch to later failures of feeding and sustaining ties. It remains anchored in word 3 and gains a causal social mechanism from the focus tyrant branch and the later needy-person sequence. Render as an exploratory social-collapse layer, not as a claim that the packet identifies Thamud's historical cause of death.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The destruction root at word 3 includes broken need and dependence, while word 4 can name an overbearing ruler or coercive order.

activation_trace.role: Broken need and dependence supply the vulnerable condition through which a community can be socially undone.
An overbearing authority supplies the social force that can produce and ignore that dependence.
Urging action supplies the absent social impulse to sustain another.
Feeding another supplies the concrete support withheld in the contextual indictment.
Humiliated poverty identifies the person exposed by the failure of support.
Close kinship supplies the sustaining tie whose absence completes social isolation.

changed_reading.before: The community is destroyed solely by an external physical event.
changed_reading.after: A live social layer emerges in which coercive excess manufactures broken need and ruins a people by withholding food, advocacy, and sustaining ties.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading isolates the focus destruction branch's image of collapsing gait and deliberately does not carry its allure-related extensions. It remains anchored in word 3 and is materially activated by the later sequence of standing collective, prostration, rear remains, and hollow interior. Render as a bodily-form analogy for loss of coherence, not as a direct lexical gloss or sexualized image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 3 can stage destruction as a progressive failure of gait and bodily coherence rather than an instantaneous disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Swaying collapse in gait supplies a kinetic, bodily phase of ruin.
Overwhelming punishment supplies the force that drives the loss of bodily organization.
Upright standing supplies the organized posture that will fail.
Being thrown to the ground supplies the posture's visible reversal.
The rear or remnant of a thing supplies the residual form left after collapse.
An emptied interior supplies the final loss of sustaining coherence.

changed_reading.before: Destruction is a punctual transition from living to dead.
changed_reading.after: Destruction can be sensed kinetically as upright communal form losing balance, falling, and becoming an emptied remnant.

strongest_changes: The repetition of the focus overstepping root with water in 69:11 changes excess from an intrinsically lethal thing into a force whose outcome depends on bearing and containment.
The movement from no remainder in 69:8 to deliberate remembrance in 69:12 changes extinction into a transfer from collective presence to preserved signal.
The recurrence of the destruction root with authority in 69:29 reverses coercive power from apparent destroyer into something that itself perishes.
Striking, noise, blown air, and impact keep an acoustic destruction reading alive beside moral, juridical, and hydrological readings.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots behave as a reversible mechanism rather than a fixed label: overstepping can be deed, force, sound, terrain, or authority, while destruction can be extinction, self-entry into peril, loss of power, collapse of support, or failure of bodily form. Context repeatedly pairs excess with containment, erasure with memory, and covering with exposure without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus noun primarily denotes external punishment, the people's own transgression, an acoustic event, or personified authority remains intentionally unresolved.
The acoustic, topographic, gait, and social readings depend on branch-distant activations and should remain qualified rather than promoted to exclusive glosses.
Later material may analogize the focus mechanism without specifying the historical modality of Thamud's destruction.
